Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In Step 10, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the Wikipedia information. The Wikipedia page clearly states: "Eastern College Athletic Conference-North (1979–1988)" and "North Atlantic Conference (1988–1996)". The Planner mistakenly swapped these dates and names in their "Updated Understanding" section, claiming the predecessor for 1988–1996 was ECAC-North, when it was actually the North Atlantic Conference. This led to the generation of a factually incorrect final answer.
